text:
Maria (Sales): heads up — MegaRetail POC hit a hard stop when we tried to reserve a Dedicated GPU pool in eu-west1 during kickoff. customer needs 8 GPUs reserved, getting error 'insufficient capacity in region'. can we swarm?
Raj (Eng-Infra): on it. can you paste the exact CLI/API call you used?
Maria (Sales): used the quickstart command from the doc: `redwoodctl pool create --name megaretail-poc --region eu-west1 --gpus a100:2 --reserved 8`
Amelia (CS): seeing similar from the booking logs: `PoolReservationError: No compatible hosts found` then followed by `QuotaExceeded: GPUs: 8/8` in the provisioning trace. pasted logs below.
DeployBot: [provisioning] Pool creation started for megaretail-poc (req id 01D3)
DeployBot: [error] PoolReservationError - No compatible hosts found in eu-west1. Suggest checking instance family availability and quotas.
Raj (Eng-Infra): OK two likely causes: 1) cloud provider short on A100 capacity in eu-west1 AZs right now, 2) account-level GPU quota hit for reserved GPUs. which tenant/account is this under?
Maria (Sales): it's under megaretail-enterprise-prod (sales acct id MR-884). Sophie (Account): we've got a soft quota bump pending but not approved, I can escalate.
Jonathan (Eng-Platform): quick mitigation: you can create a pool with mixed instance families or lower per-node GPU count. e.g. `--gpus a10g:4` or `--gpus a100:1 --fallback a10g:1` (we support multi-variant pools). try this to get the POC live while infra shops for A100.
Amelia (CS): try this command I ran successfully in staging when A100s were scarce:
```
redwoodctl pool create --name megaretail-poc-fallback --region eu-west1 --variants "a100:1@type-x,a10g:2@type-y" --reserved 8 --strategy mixed
```
Raj (Eng-Infra): also check the quota with the provider API. run `gcloud compute regions describe eu-west1 --project=MR-884` or `az vm list-usage -l westeurope` depending on provider. if quota is the blocker, Sophie please confirm the quota bump timeline.
Sophie (Account): I filed with cloud vendor support, ETA 6-12 hours for approval. I'll also add a fallback approval (allow a10g) so POC isn't blocked.
Diego (Security): a note on Private Dedicated: customer asked about KMS integration and SOC2 evidence — we can provision the pool but for production they need KMS key binding and private VPC. POC can run on hosted dedicated pool but we should document data residency.
Maria (Sales): customer also asked pricing: are POC reserves billable? can we credit them?
Amelia (CS): POCs are billable by default but we can apply a credit note for evaluation time. Sophie will coordinate.
Raj (Eng-Infra): if quota isn't the issue, next step is region capacity. I recommend trying eu-west4 or eu-central1 for immediate availability then failover routing to eu-west1 once reserved. use `--region eu-central1` in the create call.
Maria (Sales): customer prefers EU-only regions. is eu-central1 acceptable latency-wise? their prod is eu-west1 but they'll tolerate eu-central for a week.
Jonathan (Eng-Platform): yes, we'll route traffic and set model routing to the eu-central1 pool. add this policy to the route config: `preferred_regions: [eu-west1, eu-central1]` with fallback priority.
Raj (Eng-Infra): if you want me to try repro and attempt a reserved pool with smaller instance sizes I can spin up a test account (MR-884-dev) and run through provisioning steps and share commands.
Maria (Sales): please do. customer on call at 10:30 CET — would be great to have at least a fallback working.
DeployBot: [provisioning] Attempting pool create in eu-central1 -> started (req id 01D4)
DeployBot: [success] Pool megaretail-poc-euc created with 8 reserved GPUs (mixed variants).
Amelia (CS): ✅ confirmed we have a healthy pool in eu-central1. Maria, tell customer we have a fallback live, quota escalation in progress for eu-west1.
Diego (Security): we'll also send the KMS integration doc and SOC2 statement.
Sophie (Account): I initiated a temporary credit for the POC and updated ticket with the billing team. I'll follow up with contract addendum for Dedicated pricing.
Maria (Sales): amazing, thanks team. can we capture the postmortem/notes for the customer handoff? I'll create a shared doc.
Jonathan (Eng-Platform): adding two follow-ups: 1) we should add a small PS runbook for region capacity failures to the docs, 2) expose pool variant suggestion in console when A100 capacity is low. filing tickets now.
Raj (Eng-Infra): filing infra ticket to add automatic regional fallback when reservation fails.
Maria (Sales): thanks all — closing this swarm for now, will ping if eu-west1 quota still blocks after vendor reply. :thumbsup:
